clips.title: The story
paras: Parker's Lunch is a freshly prepared meal packed by Darcy in Lakeshire. Intended for Guard Parker on patrol, it offers a simple glimpse into the daily bonds and modest comforts of Redridge's defenders.

While Redridge Mountains reels under attacks from gnolls and Blackrock orcs, the small gestures of daily life persist. Darcy, a waitress at the inn in Lakeshire, packs this wholesome meal for Guard Parker, who patrols the exposed road leading south toward Duskwood. Redridge's garrison is stretched thin and isolated from Stormwind's aid, leaving individual guards to maintain long, lonely watches. Delivering this bundle not only keeps a sentry fed, but also sparks an enduring, bashful courtship between the two townspeople.
